status.classes_contexts_precedence: FROZEN (D62): policy classes, assumed contexts, separation of responsibilities and precedence are copied from the frozen text
status.lists: PROPOSED (spec §11.2): concrete host / scheme / form lists and the navigation-role lexicon are closed at generator stage 4 after owner review; NOT approved

policies.label: BLOCK
policies.rule: URL host in link-local 169.254.0.0/16 (incl. the common cloud metadata address), fd00:ec2::254, metadata.google.internal, 100.100.100.200
policies.assumed_context: The application does not legitimately receive client-supplied URLs targeting cloud metadata or link-local services

policies.label: BLOCK
policies.assumed_context: The application accepts only http(s) URLs from clients

policies.label: BLOCK
policies.rule: Host in decimal / octal / hex / dword IPv4, IPv4-mapped IPv6, userinfo @ confusion, mixed-radix forms
policies.assumed_context: The application does not legitimately receive host representations whose only function is defeating host validation

policies.label: BLOCK
policies.rule: //h, /\h, \/\/h, /%2F%2Fh, https:h, CR / LF / TAB inside a URL value
policies.assumed_context: The application does not legitimately receive scheme-relative or malformed URL forms in URL values

policies.label: ALLOW
policies.rule: Absolute http(s) URL to a public host (RFC 2606 stand-ins), no attack structure, in a non-navigation role
policies.assumed_context: The application authorizes public destinations. Destination authorization is enforced by the application or an egress policy, not by V5. Not a claim that every external callback is legitimate

policies.label: ALLOW
policies.rule: IP address or hostname in a non-URL field
policies.assumed_context: Non-URL values are not dereferenced by the application

list_notes.loopback_networks: 0.0.0.0/8 is added as a loopback alias (PROPOSED); the frozen text names localhost, 127/8 and [::1]
list_notes.private_networks: 100.64.0.0/10 (shared address space) and fe80::/10 (IPv6 link-local) are PROPOSED additions to the frozen RFC 1918 / fc00::/7 list
list_notes.public_host_suffixes: RFC 2606 reserved second-level domains and the .example TLD; benign URL and address pools must use only these
